card.name: Start of ophthalmic and route words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word that begins a dosage-form or route term, such as the O in Ophthalmic after a drug name like Timolol Maleate. Also fires on small joiners like an opening bracket or 'or' before a route or form.

modes.label: Ophthalmic after drug name
modes.description: The O of Ophthalmic right after a beta-blocker eye drop name.

modes.label: Bracket or joiner before a form
modes.description: An opening bracket or the word or just before a form or route such as Syrup or intravenously.
